## Context
Reworked per operator decision 2026-08-19. This ticket is now the MIGRATION ITSELF. The research
half — the provider capability matrix and the production-construction contract tests — was split out
to `ageless-ferny-ugandakob` (b612-1edb-efa9-4c61), which BLOCKS this ticket. Do not start here
until that matrix exists; migrating without it is guessing.

Pydantic AI v2 makes the Responses API the default for `openai:`. rebar currently pins Chat
Completions explicitly via the `openai-chat:` prefix (the deprecation repair on
`dragonish-sylphic-sheep`). This ticket performs the deliberate migration the matrix has proven safe.

## Approved rollback / cutover policy (operator, 2026-08-19)
**Config cutover is APPROVED, with a planned deprecation before the v1 rebar release.**

Concretely: providers move to `openai-responses:` behind operator-visible configuration, with a
supported way to fall back to `openai-chat:` per provider during the compatibility window. That
fallback is explicitly TEMPORARY — it carries a deprecation notice and is scheduled for removal
before v1, so this does not become a permanent dual-path maintenance burden.

Rationale for not doing a hard cutover: wire-semantic changes are the class of change that surfaces
only in production against real provider endpoints, so the fallback buys a recovery path that costs
little. Rationale for deprecating it: keeping both paths indefinitely doubles the provider surface
rebar must reason about, which is the problem this migration exists to reduce.

## Scope
- Migrate providers the matrix marks Responses-ready to `openai-responses:` explicitly.
- Add compatibility handling for ineligible custom endpoints; each retained `openai-chat:` path
  carries a documented reason.
- Wire the per-provider fallback config key, with its deprecation notice and pre-v1 removal target.
- Document the operator-facing configuration change and the observable wire-semantic differences.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every provider the matrix marks Responses-ready uses `openai-responses:` explicitly; every
      retained `openai-chat:` path cites the matrix row that justifies it.
- [ ] The contract tests from the blocking ticket are re-run against the migrated paths and the
      behavioural diff is recorded — structured output, streaming, tool calls, retries, custom base
      URLs.
- [ ] A per-provider fallback to `openai-chat:` exists, is documented, emits a deprecation notice,
      and has a named pre-v1 removal target recorded in the deprecation docs.
- [ ] Configuration and migration documentation explain the observable wire-semantic changes and how
      to exercise the fallback.
- [ ] Focused provider tests plus `make test`, `make lint`, and `make typecheck` pass.
fields.title: Migrate eligible OpenAI providers to the pydantic-ai Responses API (config cutover with pre-v1 deprecation)
